result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and sidewalks on both sides. The street is relatively narrow with mixed-use buildings, but visibility at the crossing is partially obstructed by parked vehicles.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Removing parking spaces near the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extending the sidewalk at the corners to reduce crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position.

result.summary: This narrow residential street features continuous sidewalks and a high-visibility continental crosswalk. While the narrow geometry naturally calms traffic, the lack of visible traffic control signage and sightline obstructions from parked cars near the crossing reduce overall safety.

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on both sides of the street extend right up to the crosswalk, obscuring sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides immediately adjacent to the foreground crosswalk.

hazards.name: Lack of traffic control
hazards.description: No stop sign or pedestrian crossing signage is visible to regulate vehicle behavior at this intersection.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they step into the travel lane.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install standard pedestrian crossing warning signs or 'Yield to Pedestrians' in-street signs to alert drivers to the crossing.

result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection featuring a high-visibility continental crosswalk and curb ramps with tactile warning pads. While the narrow street profile naturally limits traffic speed, the presence of parked vehicles right up to the crossing creates significant visual obstructions for both pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk obstruct sightlines between pedestrians entering the roadway and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs on both sides of the street leading up to the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent parking in the daylighting zone.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to act as a speed table and increase the visibility of pedestrians.
